name: Furrbit
notes: Furrbit: a round cream bunny with long pink-lined ears, brown paws and a white puff tail. Type NORMAL. Moves: Tackle (A), Quick Attack (B) and Growl (R). Walks at full speed: its move 1 (Tackle) reaches 1 tile, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. As the player's monster it starts every run, classic or waves, with 20% more HP (72 instead of 60; each level still adds 8), because its Normal moves are super effective on no type and Ghosts shrug them off. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: FURRBIT
